formal_statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (S T St : Submodule ℂ (Fin n → ℂ)), S ≠ ⊥ → T ≠ ⊥ → (∀ x, x ∈ St ↔ ∀ v ∈ S * T, x * v ∈ S * T) → Module.finrank ℂ S + Module.finrank ℂ T ≤ Module.finrank ℂ (S * T) + Module.finrank ℂ St
plain_statement: For nonzero subspaces S, T of C^n with coordinatewise product S*T and stabilizer St = {x : x*(S*T) inside S*T}, dim S + dim T <= dim S*T + dim St. Mirandola and Zemor, Critical pairs for the Product Singleton Bound, IEEE Trans. Inf. Theory 61(9), 2015, arXiv:1501.06419, Theorem 3.3 (any field). The one external input of L-gct-061.
title: Kneser for codes over C (Mirandola-Zemor 2015, Thm 3.3): dim S*T >= dim S + dim T - dim St(S*T)
